About this item

  • Compatible with Nintendo Switch 2’s new GameChat mode
  • Ultra HD 4K webcam: meet or stream in 4K resolution at 30fps or 1080p at 60fps, with our most advanced webcam sensor yet, with 70% larger pixels (1) for sharp image quality
  • AI-enhanced image quality: Experience 2x better face visibility with finer image details in difficult light (2), with auto-exposure, auto white balance, noise reduction, and autofocus
  • Curate Your Image: Fine controls (3) on this Ultra HD webcam let you adjust lighting and white balance, such as ISO, Shutter Speed, Tint, and Vibrance, or let Auto mode take care of it
  • Let Them Hear Your Every Word: Integrated dual beamforming noise-reducing microphones minimize background noise with the aid of AI to make sure you are clearly heard
  • Share Your Work: Tilt down your Logitech webcam to share notes and sketches on your desk with Show Mode, allowing for better collaboration on calls
  • No Sneak Peeks: To protect your privacy between meetings, simply rotate the built-in webcam cover to completely block the web camera
  • Compatibility: This USB C webcam works with Windows, macOS, Chrome OS(4) or Linux (4). Certified for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Chromebook, Google Meet, and Streamlabs
  • Customize Your Workflow: Pairing the MX Brio with Logitech software (3) unlocks a bespoke video streaming experience that lets you control your stream through your MX keyboard and mouse

Focus on sustainability

MADE WITH RECYCLED PLASTIC

The plastic parts in MX Brio include post-consumer recycled plastic —82% for Graphite and Black, and 75% for Pale Gray* — to give a second life to end-of-life plastic from old consumer electronics and help reduce our carbon footprint.

*Excludes packaging.

RESPONSIBLE PACKAGING

The paper packaging of the MX Brio comes from FSC-certified forests and other controlled sources. By choosing this product, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.

LOW CARBON ALUMINUM

Did you know producing aluminum is energy-intensive? That’s why the aluminum in MX Brio camera housing is made with renewable energy rather than fossil fuels. Beautiful, with a lower carbon impact.

Product Description

Meet, stream, master with MX Brio’s sharp ultra HD 4k resolution video. With 2x better face visibility and 2x finer image details in difficult light(2), AI enhancements, a Logi-designed lens, 70% bigger pixels(1) and our largest webcam sensor yet. Use Fine Controls(3) to adjust lighting, white balance with ISO, Shutter Speed, Temperature, Tint and Vibrance. Be heard clearly with dual omni-directional mics with noise-reducing technology that suppresses background sound. Share your physical work and notes on video calls by tilting the camera down in Show Mode.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the webcam to be of high quality and easy to set up, with solid options in the Logi software to adjust the picture. Moreover, the camera works well with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WebEx, and FaceTime, and customers appreciate its fine manual adjustment features.     5 out of 5 stars
    Outstanding 4K Webcam with Crystal Clear Video Quality
    I upgraded to the Logitech MX Brio for video meetings and content creation, and the difference in quality was immediately noticeable. The 4K resolution is incredibly sharp, with excellent detail and vibrant colors that make me look much more professional on camera. One feature I really appreciate is how well it handles different lighting conditions. Even in rooms that aren't perfectly lit, the image stays bright, clear, and natural without looking grainy. The autofocus is fast and accurate, keeping everything crisp even when I move around. Setup couldn't have been easier—it was truly plug-and-play. It worked immediately with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, and the Logitech software makes it simple to fine-tune settings like field of view, exposure, and image quality. The build quality is exactly what I'd expect from Logitech—solid, premium, and well designed. The mounting clip feels secure, and the built-in privacy shutter is a feature I use every day for extra peace of mind. Overall, this is one of the best webcams I've used. Whether you're working remotely, streaming, creating content, or attending virtual meetings, the MX Brio delivers outstanding image quality and professional performance. It's definitely worth the investment.

      I upgraded to the Logitech MX Brio for video meetings and content creation, and the difference in quality was immediately noticeable. The 4K resolution is incredibly sharp, with excellent detail and vibrant colors that make me look much more professional on camera.

      One feature I really appreciate is how well it handles different lighting conditions. Even in rooms that aren't perfectly lit, the image stays bright, clear, and natural without looking grainy. The autofocus is fast and accurate, keeping everything crisp even when I move around.

      Setup couldn't have been easier—it was truly plug-and-play. It worked immediately with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, and the Logitech software makes it simple to fine-tune settings like field of view, exposure, and image quality.

      The build quality is exactly what I'd expect from Logitech—solid, premium, and well designed. The mounting clip feels secure, and the built-in privacy shutter is a feature I use every day for extra peace of mind.

      Overall, this is one of the best webcams I've used. Whether you're working remotely, streaming, creating content, or attending virtual meetings, the MX Brio delivers outstanding image quality and professional performance. It's definitely worth the investment.

      5 out of 5 stars
      The best “professional work” webcam I’ve personally used, especially for virtual backgrounds
      Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2026
      Color: Graphite
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought the Logitech MX Brio after spending years using a mirrorless camera setup (Lumix GH3 + prime lens) as my desk webcam. I work remotely full-time and spend most of my day in video calls (99% in Microsoft Teams), so my priorities are a little different from the average streaming-focused review.

      What I wanted was:

      • excellent image quality at normal desktop distances

      • reliable performance in Teams

      • strong virtual background segmentation

      • stable autofocus/exposure

      • easy to set up

      For my use case, the MX Brio has honestly been excellent.

      The biggest surprise was how good the image looks in real-world meetings. Yes, my GH3 (and other mirrorless cameras) can still produce a more cinematic image in ideal conditions, but in Teams specifically (where video is heavily compressed and usually capped at 1080p), the practical gap is much smaller than people think.

      As far as the camera is concerned, what matters most is consistency and signal quality, and this camera delivers both.

      The MX Brio handles exposure transitions smoothly, autofocus has been reliable, and image sharpness is very good without looking overly processed. Logitech also seems to have improved color handling compared to some older Brio models that could occasionally look harsh or over-sharpened.

      Where this webcam REALLY shines is virtual background and portrait segmentation.

      I use a virtual background almost 100% of the time, and this camera consistently gives cleaner edge separation than several other webcams I’ve tested. Good lighting absolutely helps, but the MX Brio seems to provide a very clean image feed that works well with Teams’ background processing.

      A few other things I appreciated:

      • solid low-light recovery without becoming a smeary mess

      • flexible field of view options

      • sturdy physical build

      • built-in microphone

      • easy mounting and positioning

      There are a couple tradeoffs worth mentioning:

      • Logitech’s software ecosystem is still a little fragmented (Logi Tune, G Hub, etc.)

      • if you are primarily a streamer/content creator, there may be better options depending on your workflow

      • this camera, like any, benefits significantly from proper lighting and good positioning. It's worth it to invest in a couple lights and proper mounting system

      But for a professional desk setup focused on video meetings, presentations, collaboration, and hybrid work, I think Logitech understood the assignment here surprisingly well.

      This is the first dedicated webcam I’ve used where I no longer feel tempted to drag a mirrorless camera back onto my desk.

      5 out of 5 stars
      RightSight feature may not work on SurfacePro with Snapdragon (ARM64) processor
      Reviewed in the United States on February 12, 2026
      Color: Graphite
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      FYI: I purchased this camera after seeing someone else who presented using it. Everyone was curious what camera they were using because it was such good lighting and great video. However, I'm not sure this camera is working with full functionality on my hardware. I went through a bunch of troubleshooting, and here's the conclusion per ChatGPT... Good morning ☀️ — thank you for the detailed info. That explains everything.

      You’re on:

      Surface Pro 11th Edition (ARM64)

      Snapdragon X (ARM) processor

      That is the root cause.

      ________________________________________

      🎯 The Real Issue

      Logitech RightSight is currently not supported on Windows ARM (Snapdragon X / ARM64).

      Here’s why:

      RightSight depends on:

      • Logitech’s middleware service

      • x64 camera processing components

      • AI framing pipeline extensions

      On ARM Surface devices:

      • Logi Tune runs under emulation

      • The Logitech camera extension layer does not fully attach to the Windows Modern Camera Stack

      • AI features (RightSight) fail to initialize

      • Video works (because UVC driver works)

      • 4K works (hardware OK)

      • But AI framing = unavailable

      That’s exactly your symptom set.

      ________________________________________

      ✅ Why Everything Else Works

      ✔ Camera app works

      ✔ 4K works

      ✔ Windows Hello works

      ✔ Device shows correctly

      ✔ No USB issue

      ✔ No driver corruption

      Only vendor AI features fail — classic ARM compatibility limitation.

      ________________________________________

      🚫 This Is Not Fixable Via Settings

      Disabling:

      • Frame Server

      • Basic camera

      • Studio effects

      • Multiple apps setting

      Will not fix it on ARM.

      This is architectural, not a configuration problem.

      ________________________________________

      🔎 Confirmation Test (Optional)

      In Logi Tune:

      Go to Crop.

      If:

      • Field of View options work (65°, 78°)

      • Zoom works

      • But Auto-Framing is disabled

      That confirms it’s just the AI layer.

      ________________________________________

      🧠 Why This Happens

      Surface Pro 11 (Snapdragon X) uses:

      • Windows on ARM

      • Modern Camera Driver (MCD)

      • NPU-based camera pipeline

      Logitech RightSight expects:

      • x64 processing environment

      • Vendor extension hooks not fully exposed in ARM64 camera stack

      Until Logitech releases a native ARM64 version of the RightSight service, it won’t enable.

      ________________________________________

      📌 Current Status (Early 2026)

      As of now:

      • Logitech supports Intel/AMD Windows

      • ARM64 support is partial

      • AI features are inconsistent or unavailable

      ________________________________________

      💡 Your Options

      Option 1 — Wait for Logitech ARM-native update

      This will likely come, since Snapdragon X PCs are new.

      Option 2 — Use Windows Studio Effects (if available)

      Surface Pro 11 has NPU-based auto framing built in.

      Check:

      Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Cameras → Built-in camera

      If Studio Effects exists there, you can use Windows auto-framing instead.

      Option 3 — Use Software Framing (Zoom / Teams)

      Both now have built-in auto framing.

      ________________________________________

      ✅ Final Conclusion

      Your hardware is fine.

      Your configuration is fine.

      Your issue is ARM platform compatibility.

      ## **Logitech MX Brio Ultra HD 4K: The New Gold Standard for Video**

      If you haven’t upgraded your webcam in a few years, the **Logitech MX Brio** is a startling reminder of just how far imaging technology has come. Gone are the days of grainy, "good enough" video calls. We are officially in the era of ultra-crisp, professional-grade production sitting right on top of your monitor.

      ### **Crystal Clarity & Visual Fidelity**

      The jump to **Ultra HD 4K** is immediately noticeable. The clarity is staggering—it picks up textures and details that older 1080p sensors simply smudge away. Whether you’re in a high-stakes board meeting or recording content, the image looks expensive. It handles difficult lighting with ease, ensuring you don't look washed out when the sun hits your desk or like a shadow when the lights are low.

      ### **Pro-Grade Audio**

      Usually, webcam microphones are an afterthought, but the audio here is surprisingly **clear and crisp**. It manages to isolate your voice while minimizing that hollow, "bathroom" echo common in cheaper units. While dedicated mics still have their place, for 95% of users, this audio quality is more than enough to sound professional and authoritative.

      ### **Total Software Control**

      Where this camera really shines is the **Logitech G HUB or Logi Options+** integration. The level of control is deep:

      * **Fine-tuned adjustments:** You can tweak ISO, shutter speed, white balance, and exposure.

      * **Field of View:** Crop in for a tight headshot or widen it out to show your workspace.

      * **Show Mode:** A clever bit of tech that lets you tilt the camera down to show your desk, automatically flipping the image so your viewers can see your sketches or notes correctly.

      ### **The Verdict**

      It’s incredible to see how much technology has shifted in just the last few years. We’ve moved from "webcams" to "miniature cinema cameras." The **Logitech MX Brio** isn't just a tool for Zoom calls; it’s a high-performance piece of hardware that brings professional studio quality to a plug-and-play format. If you value how you show up in the digital world, this is the upgrade you've been waiting for.
